test_pack_op_basic: test the TestPackOp class to verify the pack operation works with default parameters
test_pack_drop_remainder: test the pack operation with drop_remainder set to true to drop incomplete batches
test_pack_long_sequences: test the pack operation when sequences exceed the max_seq_len parameter
test_pack_no_truncate: test the pack operation with truncate set to false to keep full sequences
test_pack_state_save_restore: test the pack operation state_dict and load_state_dict for saving and restoring pipeline state
